summary: Research artifact created from repo code, canonical TOML, thesis/shared equation owners, attached CSV, screenshots, and memory-backed prior target-selection audit.
key_findings: Canonical real rollout generation uses oracle_target_task_sampler, while render_counterfactual_rollouts_page currently uses ActorVisibleTargetSelector for live targets.

projected_area_pixels and persisted target_projected_area_pixels currently mean max clipped source OBB bb2 area over camera ids 0..2, not aggregate historic frustum coverage; projected_area_px is only a UI display label.
The attached CSV is consistent with the fallback visibility path: displayed projected_area_px=0 and visibility_score=0.35 for all rows.
Counterfactual page defaults are hard-coded and drift from .configs/build_rollouts_v1_realistic.toml.
docs/typst/thesis/sections/03-02-data-generation.typ plus docs/typst/shared/equations/entity.typ should own the unified semantics.
recommended_first_slice: Load live panel defaults from build_rollouts_v1_realistic.toml through PathConfig and RolloutDatasetWriterConfig.
Add source badges and equation-rich popovers that separate oracle target-task sampler from actor-visible selector.
Rename or qualify current projected_area_px display and add a warning for all-zero fallback rows.
Prepare a tested historic projection aggregator as a separate schema-aware follow-up.
architect_revision_notes: Corrected live mixture wording: automatic five-family helper preserves selected budget, default 60; manual advanced overrides can diverge.
Separated UI display label projected_area_px from schema fields projected_area_pixels and target_projected_area_pixels.
